newsitem.title: USA: Gourmet magazine rates top U.S. restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Gourmet magazine rates top U.S. restaurants.

text.p: If you are French, very expensive and a restaurant, they love you in Manhattan.

So Gourmet magazine found when, for the first time in its 55 years as one of the country's leading food magazines, it decided to ask its readers what restaurants they thought were the best in 23 U.S. and Canadian cities.
The magazine said it sent detailed surveys to 29,000 subscribers and got more than 7,000 responses, discovering that six of the top 10 restaurants in New York are French and very, very expensive.

New Yorkers named Lespinasse as the city's best restaurant, La Grenouille as the place with the best service, La Cote Basque as the place to go for the best wine list and Chanterelle as the restaurant for special occasions.
The best restaurants were also French in Boston, New Jersey, Honolulu and Montreal, where one would expect French restaurants to do well.

Gail Zweigenthal, Gourmet's editor-in-chief, said she was surprised at how well hotel restaurants did in the survey, especially ones run by Ritz-Carlton, whose dining rooms in San Francisco and Chicago were rated the cities' best restaurants.
The best restaurant in the Washington, area, according to the survey, was not in the capital but a 30-minute drive into Virginia, the Inn at Little Washington.
Zweigenthal said one of the best restaurants in the United States, Al Forno in Providence, Rhode Island, was not in the survey "because we just didn't rank Providence."
